name: flipbook
description: Record a browser window while Claude drives it, and get back keyframes and a timeline Claude can actually read.
long_description: Claude can't watch video. Flipbook records your web app while Claude drives it and hands back a flipbook it can read: a labelled contact sheet, full-resolution key frames, and a timeline of what changed and when. It catches what screenshots miss — spinners, layout shift, flicker, double-submits, and toasts that appear and vanish. Recording needs macOS 15+ and Screen Recording permission; analysing an existing recording (.mov, .mp4, .webm, .gif, or a folder of stills — including Playwright and Cypress videos) works on macOS, Linux and Windows. Everything stays on your machine.

tools.name: doctor
tools.description: Check what this machine can do: record, analyse, or neither — and why.

tools.name: stop_recording
tools.description: Stop, and return a contact sheet, key frames and a timeline to judge against a rubric.

tools.name: analyze_recording
tools.description: The same evidence for any video, animated GIF or folder of stills.

tools.name: get_frames
tools.description: Full-resolution frames at exact times, over a range, or after a mark.

tools.name: list_recordings
tools.description: Browse past recordings and their disk footprint.

tools.name: prune_recordings
tools.description: Reclaim disk from old recordings — a dry run unless confirmed.
